title: Simulating Life Paths with Digital Twins: AI-Generated Future Selves Influence Decision-Making and Expand Human Choice
reasoning: The paper investigates the psychological impact of AI-generated avatars on human decision-making. While it includes a substantial discussion on the ethical implications of persuasive AI and autonomy, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within the AI models themselves; its primary evaluation focuses on psychological and behavioral outcomes in humans.
